news.body: First half 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.69 (up from ₹2.41 in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹289.7m (up 109% from 1H 2025). Net income: ₹12.5m (up 94% from 1H 2025). Profit margin: 4.3% (down from 4.6% in 1H 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.
